verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r="app/q/[slug]/route.ts",a="app/(main)/circles/actions.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(r)||!fs.existsSync(a)){console.error("SCAN-774: a file the probe must read is missing");process.exit(79)}const route=fs.readFileSync(r,"utf8"),act=fs.readFileSync(a,"utf8");const sig=act.match(/export async function joinCircle\(([\s\S]*?)\)\s*:/);const actionTakesInvited=!!(sig&&/invited/.test(sig[1]));const routeTrustsRow=/joinCircle\(code\.circle_id, circle\.slug, \{ invited: true \}\)/.test(route)&&!/host_id|steward|isStaff|platform_staff/.test(route);if(actionTakesInvited||routeTrustsRow){console.error("SCAN-774: a member can still join a closed or paid circle without an invite: "+(actionTakesInvited?"the exported joinCircle Server Action still accepts an invited flag any client can pass; ":"")+(routeTrustsRow?"the /q resolver still passes invited:true for any circle code without checking that its creator is the circle host, a Space steward or staff.":""));process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The exported joinCircle Server Action took an invited flag any browser could POST, and the /q resolver passed invited:true for every circle code without asking who minted it, while the qr_codes insert policy let a member insert a row with any circle_id or space_id. The join body now lives in lib/circles/join.ts (joinCircleAsMember, not an action); the action takes only circleId and slug and always passes invited:false. The route selects the code's created_by and the circle's host_id and space_id and raises invited only when lib/qr/circle-invite.ts says the minter is the Host, a steward of the Space (owner or active editor+), platform staff, or an operator code with no minter; the lead-grab branch likewise requires the code's owner to steward code.space_id. Migration 20270345011800 revokes table-wide insert and update on qr_codes from anon and authenticated and grants back only the personal-code columns on insert and title, style, target_url, active on update. Pinned by lib/qr/circle-invite.test.ts, the circle-branch cases in app/q/[slug]/route.test.ts, the no-invited-door case in join-privacy.test.ts, and the pgTAP file supabase/tests/qr_codes_member_write_columns.test.sql.
